preconditions.description: The size of the tree and the number of queries are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: len(parents) == n - 1 and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in parents)
preconditions.description: The parents list has exactly n-1 elements, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(vi >= 1 and vi <= n for vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query index is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= centroid <= n for centroid in output)
postconditions.description: Each output centroid index is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(is_centroid(subtree_size, descendant_sizes, centroid) for subtree_size, descendant_sizes, centroid in zip(subtree_sizes, descendant_sizes_list, output))
postconditions.description: Each output centroid satisfies the centroid condition for its respective subtree.
